package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"time"

	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/wasi"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/artifact"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/evidence/record"
	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/model/choice"
)

type testCase struct {
	Name        string `json:"name"`
	Module      string `json:"module"`
	Fuel        uint64 `json:"fuel"`
	Memory      uint64 `json:"memory_bytes"`
	Wall        uint64 `json:"wall_millis"`
	Modeled     bool   `json:"modeled"`
	Termination string `json:"termination"`
}

func main() {
	helper := flag.String("helper", "", "authenticated baseline helper")
	corpus := flag.String("corpus", "", "shared fixture corpus")
	output := flag.String("output", "", "new private artifact root")
	choices := flag.Bool("choices", false, "execute runtime choice fixture")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := run(*helper, *corpus, *output, *choices); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run(helper, corpus, output string, choices bool) error {
	helperBytes, err := os.ReadFile(helper)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	helperHash := record.HashBytes(helperBytes)
	if helperHash != "sha256:b25439140f0c850a82f99471c9fd48ac864569a75e407a76850873f6ece055a1" {
		return fmt.Errorf("baseline helper identity mismatch")
	}
	input, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(corpus, "foundation-execution.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var document struct {
		Schema   string     `json:"schema"`
		Profile  string     `json:"profile"`
		ReadStep uint64     `json:"read_step_nanos"`
		Seeds    []uint64   `json:"seeds"`
		Cases    []testCase `json:"cases"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(input, &document); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if document.Schema != "gomad.foundation-execution-corpus/v1" || len(document.Cases) != 6 || len(document.Seeds) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("incomplete inspect corpus")
	}
	if choices {
		document.Cases = []testCase{
			{Name: "runtime-choice", Module: "targets/inspect-choice.wat", Fuel: 100000, Memory: 65536, Wall: 1000, Modeled: true, Termination: "exit"},
			{Name: "runtime-choice-overflow", Module: "targets/inspect-choice-overflow.wat", Fuel: 100000, Memory: 65536, Wall: 1000, Modeled: true, Termination: "capacity"},
		}
		document.Profile = wasi.CooperativeProfile
		document.ReadStep = 0
	}
	if err := os.Mkdir(output, 0700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, test := range document.Cases {
		for _, seed := range document.Seeds {
			module := filepath.Join(corpus, test.Module)
			moduleBytes, err := os.ReadFile(module)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			moduleHash := record.HashBytes(moduleBytes)
			config := wasi.Config{Profile: document.Profile, WorkingDirectory: "/", Environment: []string{"PWD=/"}, Clock: wasi.ClockPolicy{ReadStepNanos: document.ReadStep}, Limits: wasi.Limits{OutputBytes: 1024, TranscriptBytes: 4096, Calls: 100, Descriptors: 16, Files: 16, FilesystemBytes: 4096, PendingEvents: 16}}
			request := wasi.Request{HelperPath: helper, HelperSHA256: string(helperHash)[7:], ModulePath: module, ModuleSHA256: string(moduleHash)[7:], Engine: wasi.PinnedEngine(), InitialMemoryPages: 1, MemoryBytes: test.Memory, Fuel: test.Fuel, Config: config, Timeout: time.Duration(test.Wall) * time.Millisecond}
			if test.Name == "memory" {
				request.InitialMemoryPages = 2
			}
			arguments := []string{}
			environment := map[string]string{}
			if test.Modeled {
				arguments = []string{"fixture"}
				environment["PWD"] = "/"
				request.Config.Args = arguments
				for _, function := range []struct {
					name   string
					params []string
				}{{"fd_write", []string{"i32", "i32", "i32", "i32"}}, {"clock_time_get", []string{"i32", "i64", "i32"}}, {"args_sizes_get", []string{"i32", "i32"}}, {"random_get", []string{"i32", "i32"}}} {
					request.Imports = append(request.Imports, wasi.Import{Module: "wasi_snapshot_preview1", Name: function.name, Params: function.params, Results: []string{"i32"}})
				}
			}
			buildKey := string(record.HashBytes([]byte("gomad.fixture-wat-source/v1")))[7:]
			choiceLimit := uint64(4096)
			overflow := test.Name == "runtime-choice-overflow"
			if overflow {
				choiceLimit = 160
			}
			if choices {
				implementation, err := choice.ImplementationIdentity(buildKey)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				target, err := moduleHash.Bytes()
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				request.Imports = nil
				for _, name := range []string{"config", "decision", "observation", "finish", "idle"} {
					request.Imports = append(request.Imports, wasi.Import{Module: "gomad_wasm_v1", Name: name, Params: []string{"i32", "i32"}, Results: []string{"i32"}})
				}
				request.Runtime = &wasi.RuntimeControl{Seed: seed, Choice: &backends.ChoiceRequest{Mode: choice.ModeRecord, ExecutionIdentity: choice.ExecutionIdentity{TargetSHA256: target, ToolchainBuildKey: buildKey, GOOS: "wasip1", GOARCH: "wasm", ImplementationSHA256: implementation}, Limit: choiceLimit}}
			}
			result, err := wasi.Run(context.Background(), request)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s.seed%d: %w", test.Name, seed, err)
			}
			if !result.Reaped || result.Cancelled {
				return fmt.Errorf("incomplete fresh execution")
			}
			termination := result.Termination
			if result.WatchdogTimeout {
				termination = "watchdog_timeout"
			}
			if termination != test.Termination {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s termination: %s", test.Name, termination)
			}
			world, worldPayloads := record.NoneWorld()
			manifest := record.ExecutionRecord{
				SchemaVersion: record.SchemaVersion, ArtifactKind: record.ArtifactRunnerFailure, CreatedAt: "2026-10-20T00:00:00Z", CampaignID: "inspect-reference", Seed: record.Uint64String(seed), ReplayMode: record.ReplayNone,
				Runner:      record.Runner{RecordContract: record.RecordContract, RunnerBuild: "1d7b37f00a74a85399993f1edcad6fe742e778e3", HostOS: runtime.GOOS, HostArch: runtime.GOARCH},
				Toolchain:   record.Toolchain{GoVersion: runtime.Version(), BuildKey: string(record.HashBytes([]byte("gomad.fixture-wat-source/v1")))[7:], TargetGOOS: "wasip1", TargetGOARCH: "wasm"},
				Target:      record.Target{Kind: "exec", Source: test.Module, SHA256: moduleHash, Size: record.Uint64String(len(moduleBytes)), Argv: append([]string{"gomad-target"}, arguments...), BuildTags: []string{}, Adapters: []record.TargetAdapter{}, Compatibility: []record.CompatibilityPack{}, BuildInfo: record.BuildInfo{GoVersion: runtime.Version(), Path: "gomad.fixture-wat-source/v1"}},
				IOProfile:   record.IOProfile{Name: document.Profile, ImplementationSHA256: record.SHA256(wasi.ImplementationSHA256()), Inventory: "{}", InventorySHA256: record.HashBytes([]byte("{}"))},
				Environment: []record.Environment{{Name: "GOMADSEED", Value: fmt.Sprint(seed)}, {Name: "GOMAD_IO_PROFILE", Value: document.Profile}},
				Limits:      record.Limits{ExecutionTimeoutNanos: record.Uint64String(request.Timeout), OverallTimeoutNanos: record.Uint64String(request.Timeout), OutputBytes: 1024, WorldTransitionBytes: 4096, IOTranscriptBytes: 4096}, World: world,
				Outcome: record.Outcome{Domain: "runner", Reason: termination, Termination: "none"},
				Streams: record.Streams{Stdout: stream(result.Stdout), Stderr: stream(result.Stderr)},
				Host:    record.Host{StartedAt: "2026-10-20T00:00:00Z", FinishedAt: "2026-10-20T00:00:00Z"},
			}
			if choices {
				manifest.Environment = append(manifest.Environment, record.Environment{Name: "GOMAD_CHOICE_PROFILE", Value: choice.Profile})
			}
			if test.Modeled {
				manifest.Environment = append(manifest.Environment, record.Environment{Name: "PWD", Value: "/"})
			}
			manifest.Environment = append(manifest.Environment, record.Environment{Name: "TZ", Value: "UTC"})
			sort.Slice(manifest.Environment, func(i, j int) bool { return manifest.Environment[i].Name < manifest.Environment[j].Name })
			if result.ExitCode != nil {
				exit := record.Uint64String(*result.ExitCode)
				manifest.Outcome.ExitCode = &exit
				manifest.Outcome.Termination = "exit"
				manifest.Outcome.Domain = "target"
				manifest.Outcome.Reason = "nonzero_exit"
				manifest.ArtifactKind = record.ArtifactTargetFailure
				manifest.ReplayMode = record.ReplayExact
				if exit == 0 {
					manifest.ArtifactKind = record.ArtifactSuccess
					manifest.Outcome.Domain = "success"
					manifest.Outcome.Reason = "completed"
				}
			}
			if len(result.Transcript) != 0 {
				manifest.IOProfile.Transcript = &record.IOTranscript{Schema: "gomad.io-transcript/v1", SHA256: record.HashBytes(result.Transcript), Bytes: record.Uint64String(len(result.Transcript)), Records: record.Uint64String(result.Calls)}
			}
			var choiceTrace []byte
			if choices {
				trace := result.ChoiceTrace
				terminal := "complete"
				if overflow {
					// The baseline retains a capacity stop's authentic prefix separately from a completed trace.
					trace, err = choice.DecodeStoredTrace(choice.Profile, result.PartialHelperChoice, choice.TerminalMetadata{State: choice.TerminalOverflow, Limit: choiceLimit, Records: uint64(len(result.PartialHelperChoice) / 96), SHA256: sha256.Sum256(result.PartialHelperChoice)})
					if !errors.Is(err, choice.ErrOverflow) {
						return fmt.Errorf("expected retained overflow trace: %w", err)
					}
					terminal = "overflow"
					manifest.Outcome.Reason = "choice_trace_overflow"
				}
				manifest.Limits.ChoiceTraceBytes = record.Uint64String(choiceLimit)
				manifest.ChoiceProfile = &record.ChoiceProfile{Name: choice.Profile, ImplementationSHA256: record.SHA256FromSum(request.Runtime.Choice.ExecutionIdentity.ImplementationSHA256), Trace: record.ChoiceTrace{Schema: "gomad.choice-trace/v3", SHA256: record.SHA256FromSum(trace.SHA256), Bytes: record.Uint64String(len(trace.Bytes)), Records: record.Uint64String(trace.Summary.Records), BranchingRecords: record.Uint64String(trace.Summary.Branching), TerminalState: terminal, Limit: record.Uint64String(choiceLimit)}}
				if !overflow {
					tape, err := choice.ProjectReplayPlan(trace, request.Runtime.Choice.ExecutionIdentity)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
					manifest.ChoiceProfile.Trace.TapeSHA256 = record.SHA256FromSum(tape.SHA256)
					manifest.ChoiceProfile.Trace.Decisions = record.Uint64String(len(tape.Decisions))
				}
				choiceTrace = trace.Bytes
			}
			published, err := artifact.PublishArtifact(artifact.Store{Root: filepath.Join(output, "artifacts"), Key: artifact.StoreKeyRecord}, artifact.ArtifactInput{Manifest: manifest, TargetPath: module, Stdout: result.Stdout, Stderr: result.Stderr, IOTranscript: result.Transcript, ChoiceTrace: choiceTrace, World: worldPayloads})
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s.seed%d publish: %w", test.Name, seed, err)
			}
			verified, err := artifact.OpenArtifact(published.Path)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if err := verified.Close(); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			raw, err := json.Marshal(result)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			name := fmt.Sprintf("%s-seed%d.raw.json", test.Name, seed)
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, name), raw, 0600); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			rows = append(rows, map[string]any{"name": test.Name, "seed": seed, "artifact": published.Path, "record_hash": published.Manifest.RecordHash, "raw_result": name, "raw_sha256": record.HashBytes(raw), "arguments": arguments, "environment": environment, "termination": termination, "helper_sha256": helperHash})
		}
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"schema": "gomad.inspect-go-reference/v1", "corpus_sha256": record.HashBytes(input), "records": rows})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "reference.json"), encoded, 0600); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Println(string(encoded))
	return nil
}

func stream(data []byte) record.Stream {
	return record.Stream{FullSHA256: record.HashBytes(data), TotalBytes: record.Uint64String(len(data)), RetainedBytes: record.Uint64String(len(data))}
}
